scope.success_condition: NORMAL/bound camera -> factory/provisioning state using only nearby radio frames; attacker is not associated, has no PSK, no IP reachability and no physical access.
scope.important_boundary: TPAP/RTSP/ONVIF/HTTPS findings are chain-completion surfaces after a state pivot; they are not by themselves an S1 trigger while the camera remains a normal Wi-Fi STA.

priorities.evidence_needed: bounded disconnect/roam failure sequence followed by Tapo_Cam_* or config erasure

priorities.question: Is there a pre-association parser surface in driver/firmware/P2P/WPS/DPP handling?
priorities.evidence_needed: specific management/action frame class reaches a parser before association
